document.abstract: THE Standardization Committee of the Motion Picture Chamber of Commerce, made up of agencies that are interested in developing the motion picure service in the non-theatrical field, was formed for the purpose of setting up standards for the efficient operation of the portable motion picture projector. It is the purpose of this Committee to set up operating standards to meet conditions which usually occur in lodge rooms, churches, schools and other places in which the non-theatrical exhibitor is called upon to show film.
